q: What is the minimum attendance required to write exams?
a: You need at least *75% attendance in every subject* to be eligible for the semester end exam (SEE). Students below this may be detained in that subject.
CIE (Continuous Internal Evaluation) is out of *50 marks*: IA-1 (20) + IA-2 (20) + Assignment (10). Use the *CIE Calculator* in the menu to see what you need in the SEE.
SEE is the Semester End Examination, conducted for 100 marks and scaled to 50. Final result = CIE (50) + scaled SEE (50). You need at least 35/100 in SEE and 40/100 overall to pass.
A student whose attendance is below the required minimum in a subject is detained in that subject and cannot appear for its SEE until the shortage is cleared as per college rules.

q: How do I apply for a bonafide or other certificate?
a: Choose *Certificates* from the menu, pick the certificate type and pay the fee online. I will track the request and message you here when it is ready.
The central library is open Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Please confirm with the library for exam-time extensions.
After results are published, apply for revaluation within the notified window through the exam section and pay the prescribed fee per subject. Results are announced on the notice board.

q: How do I apply for a scholarship?
a: Scholarship details and deadlines are announced through notices. Visit the scholarship cell in the administrative block with your income certificate, marks card and fee receipt.
Classes run from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM Monday to Friday and 9:00 AM to 1:15 PM on Saturday.

q: How can I contact the college office or department?
a: Visit the department office during working hours or contact the college office. Your HOD and class mentor can also help with academic queries.

q: What is a backlog and how do I clear it?
a: A backlog is a subject you did not pass. You can reappear for it in the next SEE by registering for the supplementary exam through the exam section.
You must score at least *35 out of 100* in the SEE and at least *40 out of 100* in total (CIE + scaled SEE).
Exam dates are published as notices. Type *notifications* to see the latest circulars and timetables.

q: What if I lose my ID card?
a: Report the loss to the department office and apply for a duplicate ID card with the prescribed fee.

q: What documents are needed for a bonafide certificate?
a: Only your college ID is needed. Request it from the *Certificates* menu here - no paper form required.
College bus routes and timings are published by the transport office. Please check the transport notice board for your route.
